# eFront LMS

> eFront is an adaptable, enterprise-grade learning management system powered by AI, designed to deliver compliant, engaging training across employees, customers, and extended networks.

eFront LMS provides comprehensive training solutions with advanced features including AI-powered course creation (TalentCraft), mobile learning, SCORM/xAPI compliance, and REST API integrations. The platform serves diverse industries including technology, healthcare, finance, manufacturing, education, and energy sectors.

## Key Topics

- eFront LMS

## Training Solutions

- [Solutions Hub](https://www.efrontlearning.com/solutions): eFront solutions hub covering compliance, onboarding, customer training

- [Customer Training](https://www.efrontlearning.com/solutions/customer-training): eFront customer training platform with white-label, Zendesk, Salesforce
- [Extended Enterprise Training](https://www.efrontlearning.com/solutions/extended-enterprise): eFront extended enterprise training for employees, partners, networks
- [Continuous Training](https://www.efrontlearning.com/solutions/continuous-training): eFront continuous learning solution with skill-based training, gamification

## Industry Solutions

- [Technology & Software](https://www.efrontlearning.com/industries/technology): eFront for technology industry with SCORM, xAPI, skill development
- [Education](https://www.efrontlearning.com/industries/education): eFront for education sector with student tracking, gamification, mobile
- [Healthcare](https://www.efrontlearning.com/industries/healthcare): eFront for healthcare with certification management, compliance training
- [Manufacturing](https://www.efrontlearning.com/industries/manufacturing): eFront for manufacturing with compliance, employee engagement, safety
- [Finance & Banking](https://www.efrontlearning.com/industries/finance): eFront for finance sector with security, compliance, risk management
- [Energy](https://www.efrontlearning.com/industries/energy): eFront for energy sector with safety, compliance, hazard mitigation
